support_policy: 10.1.0 stable release with the frozen additive api-v1.5.0 contract on /api/v1. Adds scoped one-time native remote sign-in handoff, self-remote safeguards and current-device rename. RD remains disabled by default; signed grants and discovered capabilities still apply. Existing 7.0+ tunnels remain supported. Back up and test restore before deployment. The release notes identify verified and unverified coverage; incomplete runtime coverage remains explicitly unverified. FRP follows its separate upstream version.
tested_combination_scope: Historical 10.0.0 identity record retained. 10.1.0 stable component identities are listed in target_combination; exact-worker and server-image checks passed within documented scope, not a complete cross-product runtime matrix. Complete cross-product runtime acceptance pending.
